description: This file defines models and logic for event management in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including event types, events, registrations, and reporting views.

classes.name: crm_case_log
classes.description: Model extending 'crm.case.log' with custom create method and default user_id

classes.name: event_type
classes.description: Model representing event types with a name field

classes.name: event
classes.description: Model representing events with fields for dates, type, registration limits, and state, including methods for state transitions and related computations

classes.name: event_registration
classes.description: Model for event registrations, inheriting 'crm.case', with methods for email notifications, invoice line creation, and state management

classes.name: report_event_registration
classes.description: Database view model for reporting events and registration counts

classes.name: report_event_type_registration
classes.description: Database view model for reporting registration counts per event type

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new record with default values, e.g., for crm.case.log and event.registration

methods.name: write
methods.description: Updates existing records, with additional logic for related fields in event and registration models

methods.name: button_draft
methods.description: Sets event state to draft

methods.name: button_cancel
methods.description: Sets event state to cancel

methods.name: button_done
methods.description: Sets event state to done

methods.name: button_confirm
methods.description: Confirms the event and triggers email confirmation if configured

methods.name: _get_register
methods.description: Computes the number of confirmed registrations for an event

methods.name: _get_prospect
methods.description: Computes the number of unconfirmed (draft) registrations for an event

methods.name: mail_user_confirm
methods.description: Sends auto confirmation email to registered users

methods.name: mail_user
methods.description: Sends auto registration and confirmation emails based on event settings

methods.name: _history
methods.description: Logs case history entries for registration actions

methods.name: button_reg_close
methods.description: Marks registration as done and logs history

methods.name: button_reg_cancel
methods.description: Cancels registration and logs history

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a registration, setting related fields from the event

methods.name: write
methods.description: Updates registration, adjusting related fields from the event

methods.name: onchange_badge_name
methods.description: Updates badge name based on input

methods.name: onchange_contact_id
methods.description: Updates badge and email info based on contact selection

methods.name: onchange_event
methods.description: Updates price and label based on selected event

methods.name: onchange_partner_id
methods.description: Updates partner-related fields and contact info

methods.name: onchange_partner_invoice_id
methods.description: Updates price and label based on invoice partner

methods.name: onchange_categ_id
methods.description: Updates probability based on category

methods.name: _map_ids
methods.description: Helper to map case actions to related cases

methods.name: case_close
methods.description: Closes related cases

methods.name: case_escalate
methods.description: Escalates related cases

methods.name: case_open
methods.description: Opens related cases

methods.name: case_cancel
methods.description: Cancels related cases

methods.name: case_pending
methods.description: Marks related cases as pending

methods.name: case_reset
methods.description: Resets related cases

methods.name: case_log
methods.description: Logs case activity

methods.name: case_log_reply
methods.description: Replies to case logs

methods.name: add_reply
methods.description: Adds reply to case

methods.name: remind_partner
methods.description: Reminds partner about case

methods.name: remind_user
methods.description: Reminds user about case

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the report view for event registrations
